descriptionText: Some GitHub Actions provide functionality that is already built into GitHub-hosted runners, making them superfluous. Using these actions adds unnecessary dependencies and potential security risks. Examples include: release actions when 'gh release' CLI is available; comment creation actions when 'gh pr comment' / 'gh issue comment' are available; Docker run actions when 'docker run' or container steps work natively; and toolchain setup actions when package managers like rustup/cargo are already installed. Using built-in runner functionality is simpler, faster, more maintainable, and reduces the attack surface by eliminating third-party action dependencies. Consider using script steps with built-in tools instead.
